name: AR_CASH_REMIT_REFS_ALL
description: This table stores the references on a receipt

columns.name: REFERENCE_SOURCE
columns.description: This is internally used column to track the source of remittance reference. For example Lockbox, Create Spreadsheet, and Create Receipt UI.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates application that last updated this row. Foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates program that last updated this row. Foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: MATCHING_DATE_REFERENCE
columns.description: Date of the document in the INVOICE_REFERENCE column.

columns.name: PAY_UNRELATED_CUSTOMERS
columns.description: Flag that indicates pay unrelated customer transactions.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_REASON
columns.description: Customer reason codes for deductions and overpayments associated with the transaction from the remittance reference.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE
columns.description: Original transaction date from the remittance reference.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Original transaction due date from the remittance reference.

columns.name: TAX_WITHHOLDING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Withholding tax amount on the transaction from the remittance reference.

columns.name: VAT_AMOUNT
columns.description: VAT amount on the transaction from the remittance reference.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Discount amount applied to the transaction or transaction line from the remittance reference.

columns.name: DEDUCTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Deduction amount applied to the transaction or transaction line from the remittance reference.

columns.name: DEDUCTION_DETAILS
columns.description: Details about the deduction amount applied to the transaction or transaction line from the remittance reference.

columns.name: DEDUCTION_ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.description: Activity code for the deduction amount applied to the transaction or transaction line from the remittance reference. Valid values are derived from the ORA_AR_REM_DEDUCTION_CODE lookup.
